lines: The team now has a door of its own. The admin console opens to staff, and only to staff.
Staff sign in with their work email and password, and land on the Dashboard, with their name and role in the sidebar.
A member without a staff role is told the console is for the team. Wrong credentials get one message that never says which.
Four areas sit in the sidebar. Choose one, and it opens without reloading the page, marked as the current page.
On a phone or tablet, the sidebar becomes a band. The links scroll within it, and Sign out stays in reach.
Open a staff page without a session, and you are taken to sign in. If the server fails, you are told so.
On the server, every admin endpoint needs a staff session, in its own strict cookie. A member's session opens nothing.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, the second step, and the lockout.
That's slice nine point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
